# Wildbox

> An open-source, self-hosted security operations platform. Unified SIEM, SOAR, CSPM, WAF, and automated incident response in a single, community-driven solution.

Wildbox provides an end-to-end security suite designed for organizations seeking full sovereignty over their security data. It combines real-time threat detection, automated playbook response, multi-cloud posture management (CSPM), web application firewalling, and local LLM-assisted threat triage without sending telemetry to external third parties.

## Core Services & Architecture

- **Gateway Service (`open-security-gateway`)**: Unified ingress reverse proxy, API key validation, rate limiting, and route dispatching.
- **Identity Service (`open-security-identity`)**: RBAC, JWT authentication, user lifecycle management, and audit logging.
- **Tools Service (`open-security-tools`)**: Security tooling runner (Nmap, nuclei, vulnerability scanners, OSINT lookups).
- **Agents Service (`open-security-agents`)**: Autonomous AI security agents for log analysis, alert triage, and threat enrichment.
- **Responder Service (`open-security-responder`)**: Automated SOAR playbooks, firewall rule updates, IP blacklisting, and notification dispatch.
- **CSPM Service (`open-security-cspm`)**: Cloud security posture management across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes.
- **Data Service (`open-security-data`)**: High-throughput telemetry ingestion, normalization, and SIEM search engine.

## Quickstart & Deployment

Wildbox is fully self-hosted via Docker and Docker Compose:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fabriziosalmi/wildbox.git
cd wildbox
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up -d
```

Access the web dashboard at `http://localhost:3000` (or configured reverse proxy) and the API gateway at `http://localhost:8080`.

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/fabriziosalmi/wildbox): Source code, issues, and discussions

## Technical Specifications

- **License**: MIT License
- **Backend Stack**: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Uvicorn, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+
- **Security & Privacy**: Zero third-party telemetry, 100% self-hosted, air-gapped capable
- **Author**: Fabrizio Salmi (@fabriziosalmi)
